recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, kitsch-inspired digital collage featuring stylized portraits of a man and woman in 1950s glamour style, surrounded by pin-up figures and liquid gold elements against a textured crimson background.
coreVisualRelationships: Central romantic duo as the primary focal point
Diagonal flow from top-left script to bottom-right display text
Vertical stack of miniature pin-up figures balancing the left side
Contrast between soft airbrushed skin and sharp metallic gold accents
coreInvariants: Star-shaped lens flares on metallic surfaces

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large-scale central portraits dominate the upper two-thirds; secondary miniature figures occupy the lower-left quadrant.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The woman's face in the center, framed by dark hair and white fur.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top-left script, follows the woman's gaze to the man, then drops to the large diagonal title at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dense composition with minimal negative space, primarily concentrated in the upper-right and far-left edges.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Crimson red with painterly texture serves as the canvas and atmosphere.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright white fur and smoke provide high-value contrast against the red.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Reflective gold and warm yellow used for liquid, jewelry, and typography.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the reds and yellows; high value contrast between the dark hair and white fur.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to warm tones and neutrals

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Cursive script and heavy brush script
letterConstructionRules: Top text: Thin, elegant monolinear script with long, sweeping ascenders and descenders.
Bottom text: Heavy, bold brush script with a strong upward diagonal baseline and thick black drop shadows.
Consistent 45-degree slant for the main title.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Initial 'M' features an elongated vertical stem that anchors the bottom-left corner.
Terminal 's' ends in a tight, stylized curl.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A delicate, airy script at the top paired with a heavy, grounded brush script at the bottom for weight balance.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, retro brush feel of the main title.
Captures the mid-century casual script energy.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a textured red background with a central airbrushed portrait of a glamorous 1950s couple. Include a martini glass on the left with liquid gold overflowing and miniature pin-up girls skiing on the liquid at the bottom.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a large, gold-gradient brush script title diagonally across the bottom right with a heavy black shadow. Add a thin, elegant gold script name at the top left with star-shaped glints.

verificationChecks: Is the main title angled upwards?
Does the gold have a visible gradient and glints?
Is the background a textured, painterly red?
Are the white fur textures soft and voluminous?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subjects
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the gold liquid looks viscous and metallic.
Check that the drop shadow on the text is consistent with the lighting.
Verify the pin-up figures are integrated into the liquid elements.
Confirm the red background has visible brushstroke or sponge textures.
recipe.reuseFormula: Retro-Kitsch Airbrush + Liquid Gold Accents + Diagonal Brush Script + Crimson Textured Canvas
